title: Clean up inactive SharePoint sites
subtitle: Identify inactive sites, confirm ownership, check compliance and archive or delete safely.

steps.title: Find inactive sites
steps.evidence: Use the SharePoint admin center and activity reports to sort sites by last activity and storage

steps.title: Set an inactivity rule
steps.evidence: define an inactivity rule such as 90 days for team sites

steps.title: Check retention and legal holds
steps.evidence: Check retention policies, legal holds and linked Teams first.

steps.title: Set read only, then archive or delete
steps.evidence: Set the site read-only and archive it before deletion, with approval recorded.
